name: elementor-site-initialize
title_zh: 先定插件骨架再写第一个 Elementor Widg
tagline_zh: 新项目首次自定义 Widget 前，按预期规模选 Flat 或 Grouped 结构。
tagline_en: For first custom widget in a fresh project: pick Flat or Grouped layout by expected scale, auto-generate local.
desc_en: Initialize a local custom Elementor Widget plugin and design handoff workspace, choosing a Flat or Grouped plugin structure from expected Widget scale. Use once before the first custom Widget when no plugin scaffold exists; theme context is optional and read-only. Do not use for visual design, Widget implementation, deployment, WordPress-root discovery, or Elementor installation checks.
why_zh: 在写第一行代码前就把结构定死，避免后期因规模误判重构；主题只读保证不污染现有环境。
why_en: Locks architecture before code exists, preventing scale-mismatch refactors. Read-only theme access keeps environment untouched.
limit_zh: 只做初始化：不涉及视觉设计、Widget 实现、部署或 WordPress 根目录探测。
limit_en: Init only: no visual design, widget coding, deployment, or WP-root discovery. Requires existing Elementor; single use before first widget when no.
title_en: Scaffold plugin structure before your first Elementor widget
